action.command:
cd /workspace && (nohup bash -c '
for img in "quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7" "postgis/postgis:17-3.5-alpine" "postgres:18" "dpage/pgadmin4:9.17" "ghcr.io/valhalla/valhalla-scripted:3.9.0" "traefik:v3.7.13" "ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/server:0.2.0" "ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/generate-valhalla:latest"; do
  echo "pulling $img"; docker pull -q "$img" || echo "FAILED: $img";
done; echo ALL_PULLS_DONE' > /tmp/pulls.log 2>&1 &) && echo started

tool_call.name: terminal

summary: Pull all compose images in background
